create_retreival_dataset: create a RetreivalDataset for training with BERT tokenized captions and image features
create_retreival_dataset_val: create a RetreivalDatasetVal for evaluation with preloaded image features and caption matching
build_load_annotations: build annotations from a jsonlines file mapping image ids to caption entries for COCO or Flickr30k
tokenize_dataset_entries: tokenize caption entries using BERT tokenizer with fixed max sequence length and padding
tensorize_dataset_entries: convert tokenized caption entries to PyTorch tensors for model input
